 Willie Nelson, 93, Says His Younger Self Never Imagined
Spending 40 Years With One Woman, and His New Book Is Dedicated to
Her
Mandatory Credit: Photo by McBride/Mediapunch/Shutterstock
(8878025a)
Willie Nelson and His Wife 1984 Waldorf Astoria Hotel New York
City
Willie Nelson 1984 Waldorf Astoria Hotel New York City 
 Willie Nelson has never been known for doing things
the conventional way, including in love. Yet at 93, the country
legend has now spent four decades with the same woman, Annie
D’Angelo, something he says his younger self could never have
imagined. His new book is dedicated to her. 
 In short 
 Willie
Nelson and Annie D’Angelo met in 1986 on the set of the TV movie
Stagecoach, where she was working as a makeup artist. 
 They
married in 1991 and have two sons, Lukas and Micah, both
musicians. 
 His new
book, The Last Leaf, released on November 10, is dedicated to
Annie, whom he calls his “best friend for four
decades.” 
 A meeting on a movie set 
 Their story began in 1986, on the
set of the TV movie Stagecoach. Annie D’Angelo, a makeup artist who
had worked on films such as Bachelor Party, was in charge of the
singer’s look. The two bonded over his famous braids, which she
agreed he should not have to cut for the role. 
 They married on September 16,
1991, in Nashville. Their sons, Lukas, born in 1988, and Micah,
born in 1990, both followed their father into music. 
 “Marrying Annie wasn’t complicated at all” 
 Nelson, who had been married
three times before, has never hidden that his love life was
eventful. “When it came to romance, I had a gift for complicating
things,” he wrote in his 2020 memoir. “But marrying Annie wasn’t
complicated at all.” 
 He also admitted that “winning
her over wasn’t easy.” In a 2023 interview, he summed up their
relationship with his usual humor: “I call her my pet
rattler.” 
 A book about late-life creativity and love 
 His new book, The Last Leaf:
Reflections on Late-Life Creativity and My Longest Love Affair, was
released on November 10. According to the country music site
Whiskey Riff, it is dedicated to Annie, his “best friend for four
decades,” and revisits their first meeting on the set of
Stagecoach, as well as how she helped him through COVID. 
 “The backbone of this book is a
love story,” Nelson said when announcing it. “In a great life, like
a great book, the last chapter is the best chapter.” 
 A legend who never slowed down 
 Born in Texas in April 1933,
Nelson has spent more than six decades writing and recording, from
Crazy, made famous by Patsy Cline, to On the Road Again and his
version of Always on My Mind. Through it all, Annie has been at his
side for the last 40 years, on the road and at home. 
 Forty years, and still going 
 Promoting the book this week,
Nelson reflected that his younger self could never have pictured
spending 40 years with one woman. Hollywood has its own
long-lasting couples, from 
Goldie Hawn and Kurt Russell, still in the Colorado log home they
built in the 1980s to 
the Hart to Hart stars, 47 years later . 
 For a man who wrote some of the
most famous songs about restless hearts, the happiest chapter may
be the one he is living now.
